previous_audits.chain_closure_explanation: Within the stated Wilson nearest-neighbor source grammar, the six plaquette orientations induce equal directional weights and the minimal APBC spatial cube gives three unit spatial gaps, yielding K_O(omega) = 3w(3 + sin^2 omega). The endpoint ratio then follows algebraically from the Lt=2 sum and the standard infinite-time trigonometric average; no downstream plaquette-observable closure is claimed.
previous_audits.claim_scope: Exact temporal-completion ratio for the accepted Wilson nearest-neighbor local bosonic scalar gauge-source class with one uniform plaquette weight on the minimal APBC 3 spatial + 1 derived-time block.

first_audit.claim_scope: Exact algebraic theorem for the explicitly scoped accepted Wilson nearest-neighbor local bosonic scalar gauge-source class: one common plaquette weight on all six orientations, no anisotropic orientation splitting, no independent site term, APBC minimal spatial cube L_s=2, and the directional sin^2 kernel readout A_O(L_t) = (1/(2L_t)) sum_omega 1/K_O(omega). It does not audit the full interacting gauge-vacuum plaquette expectation or any observable-level plaquette bridge.

second_audit.claim_scope: Exact temporal-completion ratio for the accepted Wilson nearest-neighbor local bosonic scalar gauge-source class with one uniform plaquette weight on the minimal APBC 3 spatial + 1 derived-time block.

third_audit.claim_scope: Exact algebraic theorem for the explicitly bounded Wilson nearest-neighbor scalar gauge-source class: one common plaquette weight across the six orientations, no independent site term, no anisotropic plaquette splitting, directional kernel K_O(p)=sum_mu a_mu sin^2 p_mu, evaluated on the L_s=2 APBC minimal spatial cube with A_O(L_t)=(1/(2L_t)) sum_omega 1/K_O(omega). It does not audit the full interacting plaquette expectation bridge.

previous_audits.load_bearing_step: Every accepted source reduces exactly to K_O(omega) = 3w (3 + sin^2 omega), so the normalization cancels and A_O(inf) / A_O(2) = 2 / sqrt(3).
previous_audits.notes_for_re_audit_if_any: Second audit should re-check the A_inf integral analytically, since the runner's endpoint-ratio PASS uses a large-Lt numerical approximation against the stated 2/sqrt(3) constant.
previous_audits.verdict_rationale: The audited claim is narrow: universality only inside the accepted Wilson nearest-neighbor scalar gauge-source grammar, excluding anisotropic terms, site terms, unrelated source classes, and the interacting plaquette expectation. The load-bearing step is a combinatorial/algebraic reduction of that scoped grammar, not a definition substitution or external numerical match. The runner checks the Wilson orientation count, induced directional equality, minimal-cube kernel reduction, normalization independence, and sensitivity to forbidden deformations; it uses no external comparators.
